title: 从主线到绒毛层次：眉形设计的9个步骤
title_en: From main strokes to fine layers: nine design steps
intro: 这组既有示意图说明纸上设计思路，不是顾客案例，也不是自行进行纹绣操作的教程。线条组织仍需结合每个人的骨骼、原生眉与喜好调整。
intro_en: These existing illustrations explain a drawing sequence. They are not client cases or instructions for carrying out a pigmentation procedure. The design still needs to respond to the individual’s structure, existing brows and preferences.

sections.title: 找出毛流线
sections.description: 先观察顺着原生长势的大弧线，作为主线排列的参考，不急着画外框。
sections.description_en: Observe the broad curve of the natural growth direction as a reference for the main strokes, before drawing the outline.

sections.title: 下框架主线依次向后
sections.description: 下框架主线顺着毛流逐渐向后，以直弧线表达方向，避免机械平行。
sections.description_en: Let the lower framework strokes progressively follow the hair direction, using gently curved lines rather than mechanical parallel marks.

sections.title: 上框架结合眉峰
sections.title_en: Relate the upper framework to the arch
sections.description: 观察眉峰前后主线的开口与方向，围绕眉峰组织上框架。
sections.description_en: Observe the openings and directions of strokes before and after the arch, and organise the upper framework around it.

sections.title: 眉头以扇形打开
sections.title_en: Open the brow start in a fan
sections.description: 每条线有自己的角度，顺应原生眉头方向，避免所有线条同向重复。
sections.description_en: Give each line its own angle, following the natural brow start rather than repeating an identical direction.

sections.title: 先检查框架衔接
sections.description: 看眉头与下框的承接，以及上、下框主线是否自然汇入毛流线。
sections.description_en: Check the transition from the brow start to the lower framework and how upper and lower strokes meet the hair-flow line.

sections.title: 补充下框辅助线
sections.description: 在需要的空隙中安排辅助线，以“个”字形的组织方式理解衔接，而不是均匀铺满。
sections.description_en: Place supporting strokes where needed. The illustrated branching arrangement explains connections; it is not a direction to fill every space.

sections.title: 补充上框辅助线
sections.description: 分配上框内部空间，结合交叉线组织层次，保留合理间距。
sections.description_en: Distribute detail within the upper framework, using crossing directions to organise layers while retaining space.

sections.title: 补充眉头辅助线
sections.description: 以交叉和人字形的组织方式讨论衔接，线条仍需服从原生毛流。
sections.description_en: Use crossing and branching arrangements to discuss transitions, while keeping the lines consistent with natural growth.

sections.title: 用绒毛线丰富层次
sections.description: 轻浅补充需要的空隙，控制范围与浓淡。不是把内部涂满，而是让结构、密度和柔和过渡协调。
sections.description_en: Add lighter, finer detail only where needed, controlling extent and tone. The aim is coordinated structure, density and soft transitions, not a filled-in block.
